```{r}
# Packages
library(caret)
library(glmnet)
library(dplyr)

```

```{r}
# Read data
Ninety_Minutes_All_Data <- read.csv("Burning Macro and Micro Data - 90 Minutes - All Data.csv",
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Set outcome
Ninety_Minutes_All_Data$Tool <- as.factor(Ninety_Minutes_All_Data$Tool)

# Remove rows with missing data
lasso_data_complete <- na.omit(Ninety_Minutes_All_Data)

# Check how many rows remain
nrow(lasso_data_complete)
```
#rows with missing macro/micro observations were excluded.

```{r}
# Separate outcome and predictors
y <- lasso_data_complete$Tool

x_raw <- lasso_data_complete %>%
  select(-Tool)

# Check near-zero variance variables
nzv_metrics <- nearZeroVar(
  x_raw,
  freqCut = 95/5,
  uniqueCut = 10,
  saveMetrics = TRUE
)

nzv_metrics

# See which variables are flagged
nzv_metrics[nzv_metrics$nzv == TRUE, ]

# Remove near-zero variance predictors
nzv_vars <- rownames(nzv_metrics[nzv_metrics$nzv == TRUE, ])

x_filtered <- x_raw %>%
  select(-all_of(nzv_vars))
```

```{r}
# Dummy-code categorical predictors
dummy_model <- dummyVars(~ ., data = x_filtered, fullRank = TRUE)

x <- predict(dummy_model, newdata = x_filtered)

# Make sure x is a matrix
x <- as.matrix(x)
```

```{r}
set.seed(42)

cv_lasso <- cv.glmnet(
  x = x,
  y = y,
  family = "multinomial",
  alpha = 1,
  type.measure = "class",
  nfolds = 10,
  standardize = FALSE
)

# Plot cross-validation curve
plot(cv_lasso)

# Best lambda
cv_lasso$lambda.min

# More conservative lambda
cv_lasso$lambda.1se
```
```{r}
# Coefficients at lambda.min
coef_min <- coef(cv_lasso, s = "lambda.min")

# Coefficients at lambda.1se
coef_1se <- coef(cv_lasso, s = "lambda.1se")
```

```{r}
# Function to pull non-zero coefficients by class
get_selected_vars <- function(coef_object) {
  selected <- lapply(coef_object, function(class_coef) {
    temp <- as.matrix(class_coef)
    rownames(temp)[temp[, 1] != 0]
  })
  
  selected <- lapply(selected, function(vars) {
    vars[vars != "(Intercept)"]
  })
  
  return(selected)
}

selected_min <- get_selected_vars(coef_min)
selected_1se <- get_selected_vars(coef_1se)

selected_min
selected_1se
```

```{r}
# Classification accuracy for lambda.min and lambda.1se

# Predicted classes for lambda.min
pred_min <- predict(
  cv_lasso,
  newx = x,
  s = "lambda.min",
  type = "class"
)

# Predicted classes for lambda.1se
pred_1se <- predict(
  cv_lasso,
  newx = x,
  s = "lambda.1se",
  type = "class"
)

# Convert predictions to factors with the same levels as your outcome
pred_min <- factor(pred_min[, 1], levels = levels(y))
pred_1se <- factor(pred_1se[, 1], levels = levels(y))

# Calculate classification accuracy
accuracy_min <- mean(pred_min == y)
accuracy_1se <- mean(pred_1se == y)

# Overall accuracy results
accuracy_min
accuracy_1se
```
```{r}
# Function for accuracy by tool type
accuracy_by_tool <- function(actual, predicted) {
  
  results <- data.frame(
    Tool = levels(actual),
    Correct = NA,
    Total = NA,
    Accuracy = NA
  )
  
  for (i in seq_along(levels(actual))) {
    
    tool <- levels(actual)[i]
    
    tool_rows <- actual == tool
    
    results$Correct[i] <- sum(predicted[tool_rows] == actual[tool_rows])
    results$Total[i] <- sum(tool_rows)
    results$Accuracy[i] <- results$Correct[i] / results$Total[i]
  }
  
  return(results)
}
```

```{r}
# Accuracy by tool type for lambda.min
accuracy_min <- accuracy_by_tool(
  actual = y,
  predicted = pred_min
)

accuracy_min

# Accuracy by tool type for lambda.1se
accuracy_1se <- accuracy_by_tool(
  actual = y,
  predicted = pred_1se
)

accuracy_1se
```

```{r}
# Confusion matrix for lambda.min
confusionMatrix(
  data = pred_min,
  reference = y
)

# Confusion matrix for lambda.1se
confusionMatrix(
  data = pred_1se,
  reference = y
)
```
